posts.name: Chris Camillo
posts.text: I’ve spent a few days thinking about the Tesla Roadster reveal and landed somewhere I haven’t seen much discussion. I’m neither a Tesla fanboy nor a Tesla hater. And I couldn’t care less whether what we saw technically qualifies as a flying car. Three takeaways: (1) The risk of that live demonstration going horribly wrong was real. Almost no CEO would willingly expose their company to that kind of public humiliation for a product with so little financial upside. Elon did. (2) That willingness to attempt the seemingly impossible is what makes Tesla special. It’s also arguably Elon’s greatest contribution to America. He’s helped bring back something we’ve lost. The American spirit of chasing big scary ideas that most people think are impossible. That mindset is spreading across a new generation of founders and its long term impact on America’s future could dwarf anything Tesla ever sells. I think this is deeply underappreciated. (3) Can we just acknowledge how insanely cool that moment was? We’ve reached a strange place culturally where even extraordinary feats of human ingenuity immediately become arguments about why they don’t count. Not everything needs to be a debate. Sometimes we should just be able to stand back together and marvel at what humans are capable of. I’ve been both bullish and critical of Tesla’s ambitions over the years. But watching Elon and his team push the boundaries of what’s possible reminds me why I’m glad we have him. Whether the Roadster ever makes Tesla a dollar or impacts $TSLA stock price is almost beside the point. We need more people willing to risk failure in pursuit of things the rest of us think are impossible. Because when they succeed we all win.

Global smartphone sales are contracting amid surging prices.

**先替火币澄清一件事。晚宴原定 6 号，后来因为安排调整改到了 8 号。工作人员是真的尽心尽力，我亲眼看着他们为了协调好每一个人，焦灼地忙了全程。办过活动的人都知道，现场总有太多突发状况：场地临时变更，容纳人数跟着变，这些未知因素导致一些 VIP 没能到场。但团队自始至终都在积极解决问题。

火币的现场活动给我一种很不一样的感觉。在其他交易所的夹击之下，来到现场的反而都是火币多年的老用户，整场氛围其乐融融，非常家人向🙏感谢 @Ceee333_ 的邀请，她是这场活动的负责人之一，也是双语主持，业务能力相当过硬。还有@HTX_Molly @Lumibb_ @Xiaodu_HTX 等火币的小伙伴，每个人都很 energetic。这是我第一次深度接触火币的活动对接团队，评价很高（我不是托，是托死全家）。

**再说说我筹划的这场采访（目前身体太差的确稍微拖延了）。我有稍微看了下孙哥和邵艾伦那场”薄肌”采访，以及和自由潜冠军金明聊 Crypto、AI 与量子威胁的那场。我想问点不太一样的人文向问题，因为我的视角可能有些特别：我是从新概念时期就知道孙哥的。同为新概念作文大赛的获奖者，他某种程度上算是我的前辈。我第一次听到这个名字，是在《萌芽》上读到他写的《一道论证题》，所以对他的文青之路一路追踪非常熟稔。

我也注意到，孙哥提到他们生态里一直比较活跃的以太坊挖矿活动，所以也想专门问问他怎么看 ETH 这个资产。对于BTC被攻破这块，我和以太坊基金会做抗量子研究和在Yale/MIT读相关PHD的一些朋友交流过，他们对 Q-Day 的到来目前还算比较乐观，这个话题也想和他聊聊。

**最后一个小提议：**除了数学奖，火币很值得再设一个文学奖/人文奖。我感觉现在这些交易所办的这种访谈活动，基本上都是跟交易员对谈，来来回回，其实也都是那些交易员，同质化程度太高了，包括打广告的 KOL 也是，基本上是今天做完交易所 A 的广告，明天又去发交易所 B 的广告。孙哥既是新概念出身，又做过社交 App（陪我），某种程度上“薄肌”也算是一种文化输出了，那是否火币可以系统性以活动的形式支持更多元的加密文化输出？

先发散到这儿，抛砖引玉，之后再细聊。

To fill 600 liter tanks at 600 bars (8700 PSI) takes, in theory, 220 MJoules. 

Taking into account the efficiency of the complex compressor requires for this, the total energy consumed would probably be around 400MJ, or about 110 kWh (more energy than a full Tesla S battery).

This would take at least 12 hours with current compressor technology (which requires dessication, cooling, etc).

All of this for a few seconds of jet boost.
